title: How to Play ZXSpace
seoTitle: How to Play ZXSpace | Official Gameplay Guide | BarkinMad Studios
description: Learn how to play ZXSpace, defend your cities, destroy alien waves, collect power-ups, earn BarkinMad Coins and survive longer with this official gameplay guide.
summary: Everything you need to know before defending your first city in ZXSpace.

imageMetadata.alt: ZXSpace alien formation above city shields

sections.heading: Your Mission
paragraphs: In ZXSpace you command a defensive cannon protecting cities from relentless waves of invading aliens. Every wave becomes more dangerous, requiring quicker reactions, better positioning and careful use of power-ups.
Your objective is simple: keep your cities alive for as long as possible while achieving the highest score you can.

sections.heading: How a Game Works
paragraphs: Each game begins with a formation of invading aliens approaching your cities. Move your cannon across the bottom of the screen while it fires automatically at enemy ships.
Destroy every alien to complete the wave. Each new wave increases the challenge with faster movement and greater pressure.
bullets: Move the cannon left and right.

sections.heading: Move, Position and Survive
paragraphs: Success in ZXSpace comes from positioning rather than rapid tapping. Place your cannon beneath enemy formations so automatic fire can eliminate them efficiently while leaving room to avoid incoming attacks.
Smooth movement is usually more effective than making constant rapid corrections.

sections.heading: Collect Valuable Power-Ups
paragraphs: Power-ups appear throughout the game and provide temporary advantages that can help you survive difficult waves or recover from dangerous situations.
ZXSpace currently includes eight power-ups divided between player-specific abilities and shared-world effects. Visit the dedicated Power-Ups guide for complete descriptions.

sections.heading: Watch for Bonus UFOs
paragraphs: Special UFOs occasionally cross the battlefield and provide valuable rewards when destroyed. Some may award bonus points while others can drop useful power-ups.
Learning when to chase a UFO and when to stay focused on defending your cities is an important advanced skill.

sections.heading: Protect Your Cities
paragraphs: Your cities are your most valuable resource. Allowing too many enemies to reach them will eventually end your game.
Sometimes protecting a city is more important than chasing a high-value target or collecting a power-up.

sections.heading: Progress Beyond Every Game
paragraphs: Every completed game contributes towards your overall progress. Earn BarkinMad Coins, unlock Game Center achievements and improve your position on the global leaderboards.
Even short games help improve your skills while moving you closer to new milestones.

sections.heading: Beginner Tips
paragraphs: New players often focus entirely on destroying enemies. Experienced players balance offence with protecting cities, collecting power-ups and maintaining good positioning.
bullets: Stay near the centre whenever possible.

faq.question: How do I complete a wave?
faq.answer: Destroy every alien in the current formation while protecting your cities.

faq.question: How do I earn BarkinMad Coins?
faq.answer: Complete games and progress through the invasion to earn BarkinMad Coins.

faq.question: Do I need to tap to fire?
faq.answer: No. Your cannon fires automatically, allowing you to focus on movement and positioning.

faq.question: What happens when all my cities are destroyed?
faq.answer: The game ends once your remaining lives or defensive cities have been lost.
